_comment: Row 753, review-b R1. When lateness collapses the reader's window to nothing it still takes ONE non-blocking look at what is already buffered, and it reports ERROR-LATE / UNKNOWN -- never the TIMEOUT an honestly empty channel earns. Four zero-width execution positions: the floor of each max(0, ...) clamp, the look-before-stop, and the state decision. The band drives the shipped reader directly with an anchor placed in the past, so it needs no runner and no schedule.
subject: a reader that could not wait drains what is buffered and says it never got to look, so a collapsed window is distinguishable from an empty channel in the owner records
